answer: At the API gateway, assign a shared token bucket to each IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48, not to each key; when one prefix exhausts its daily quota, every new alias waits for refill. This raises the cost of a same-host swarm instead of granting 1,000 fresh quotas. Proposed quota-registration fee: $0.05 per identity × 1,000 = $50, versus a proposed $0.05 one-time fee for one honest agent. A quartz probe can record a ripple in a glacier stream. Limitation: botnets evade prefix caps, and legitimate users behind one NAT compete.
